# Templates and metadata

This page documents the generated note formats and the metadata consumed by
ARC's Dataview queries. For the role of each vault layer, see
[ARC vault architecture](architecture.md); for usage examples, see
[Vault workflows](vault-workflows.md).

ARC CLI writes starter Markdown templates into `999_Templates/`. The templates contain Templater expressions, but the CLI does not install Templater, configure its settings, or automatically apply templates to new notes. See [Obsidian setup](obsidian-setup.md).

## Generated files

| File                                                  | Purpose and key content                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `000_Atlas/Dashboard.md`                              | Dataview views for active projects, open task notes, and unchecked Markdown tasks. |
| `000_Atlas/MoC_Idea_Matrix.md`                        | Capture loose ideas and connect them to Slipbox notes.                             |
| `200_Projects/210_Project_Alpha/MoC_Project_Alpha.md` | Example project note with desired outcome, active phase, archive, and task query.  |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Concept.md`                        | Atomic concept note with generated ID/date, type, tags, idea, and connections.     |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Project_Task.md`                   | Task note with project, phase, status, outcome, and next actions.                  |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Daily_Journal.md`                  | Date-based journal with focus, notes, and flash ideas.                             |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Tech_Architecture.md`              | Technical concept with API endpoint and database schema tables.                    |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Meeting_Note.md`                   | Meeting date, attendees, notes, project, and checkbox action items.                |
| `999_Templates/TPL_Weekly_Review.md`                  | Weekly maintenance checklist and next-week focus.                                  |

`arc init` also creates `.claudeignore` as a best-effort hint file. See [Obsidian setup](obsidian-setup.md#ai-and-filesystem-access).

## Frontmatter contract

Frontmatter is YAML at the beginning of a Markdown note, between `---`
delimiters. The templates provide starter values and Templater expressions;
they do not impose a schema, validate values, or guarantee that a referenced
project or phase exists.

The generated Dashboard queries expect the following metadata:

### Project notes

```yaml
type: project
status: active
deadline:
```

The suggested project status vocabulary is `active`, `on-hold`, `done`, and
`archived`. The generated example uses `active`. The Dashboard's Active
Projects table only selects `status: active`.

### Task notes

```yaml
type: task
project: 'Project Alpha'
phase: 'Phase_03_Active'
status: todo
created: 2026-10-28
deadline:
```

Suggested task status values are `todo`, `in-progress`, `done`, and `blocked`.
The template starts with `todo`, empty `project` and `phase` values, and an
empty `deadline`. Replace the project and phase with values meaningful to your
vault. The Dashboard queries task notes under `200_Projects/` where
`type = "task"` and `status != "done"`; statuses such as `blocked` are
therefore still shown as open.

The Dashboard does not filter task notes by project status or deadline and
does not validate the `project` and `phase` values.

### Other generated note types

| Template                   | Frontmatter fields                                                              | Body sections                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `TPL_Concept.md`           | `id` (timestamp generated by Templater), `type: concept`, `tags`, `created`     | Idea and Connections                                              |
| `TPL_Tech_Architecture.md` | `type: concept`, `subtype: tech-architecture`, `tags: [engineering]`, `created` | Context, API Endpoints, Database Schema, Decisions and trade-offs |
| `TPL_Daily_Journal.md`     | `type: journal`, `date`                                                         | Focus, Notes, Flash Ideas                                         |
| `TPL_Meeting_Note.md`      | `type: meeting`, `date`, `attendees`, `project`                                 | Notes, Action Items                                               |
| `TPL_Weekly_Review.md`     | `type: weekly-review`, `week`                                                   | Review checklist, Next week's focus                               |

Templater fills date, week, title, and concept ID expressions when the
template is executed. Without Templater, those expressions remain literal
text until replaced manually.

## Markdown action items

Meeting action items and other checklist tasks are Markdown checkboxes:

```markdown
- [ ] Confirm next project milestone
- [x] Share meeting notes
```

The Dashboard's Dataview `TASK` query finds incomplete Markdown tasks under
`200_Projects/` and `400_Journal/`. The project example has a separate `TASK`
query scoped to its own project folder. These checklist items are distinct
from task-note YAML metadata and can coexist with task notes. Checkboxes in
Spaces, Atlas, Slipbox, and Templates are not included by the Dashboard's
Open Action Items query.

## Generated Dataview queries

The Dashboard contains these queries:

```dataview
TABLE status, deadline
FROM "200_Projects"
WHERE type = "project" AND status = "active"
SORT deadline ASC
```

Lists project notes under `200_Projects/` with the exact metadata values
`type: project` and `status: active`.

```dataview
TABLE project, phase, status
FROM "200_Projects"
WHERE type = "task" AND status != "done"
SORT project ASC, phase ASC
```

Lists task notes under `200_Projects/` whose status is not `done`.

```dataview
TASK
FROM "200_Projects" OR "400_Journal"
WHERE !completed
```

Lists unchecked Markdown checkboxes in project and journal folders.

Dataview must be installed and enabled for these blocks to render as views.
The queries depend on folder paths, field names, and values; changing any of
those may require updating the queries. See [Obsidian setup](obsidian-setup.md).

## Maintain the contract

If you rename metadata fields, status values, or queried folders, update the
affected templates, notes, and Dataview queries together. These metadata and
query conventions are not checked by `arc verify`. Dataview must be installed
and enabled for query blocks to render.
